title: Deposit Supply and Bank Transparency
authors: Liangliang Jiang; Ross Levine; Chen Lin; Wensi Xie
eligible_reason: Treatment is continuous. The key regressor 'shale' (Bank Exposure, README) is a bank-year measure of exposure to shale-gas windfall deposits: in RegressionT.dta it takes 182 distinct values (0 to 4.70; 4.6% of bank-years nonzero) and varies year to year rather than switching on once. Main specifications (Tables 2, 4-10) are reghdfe y shale $CX, a(rcode year) cluster(rcode) with bank and year FE plus time-varying bank controls (logSIZE, wLLP, wCAP, wROA, wTier1, size-group dummies G1-G3); Table 4 cols 1-2 drop the controls but keep the continuous exposure. Tables 5-6 interact exposure with competition/opacity; Table 9 uses alternative continuous exposure measures (shale2, 190 distinct values). No binary staggered treatment, so not a near miss.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe, BHC (rcode) x year panel 2000-2007, 3,957 obs. Table 3 validation tests are bank-level cross-sections on average post-2002 exposure. Outcomes: MD&A length/modification, voluntary 8-K frequency/length, management guidance frequency/precision, deposits.
data_files_note: Analysis files shipped (built from FR Y-9C, SoD, EDGAR, IHS Markit, SDC, First Call).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no abstract in candidates/frame). Title and authors from readme.txt (dated 2021). Continuous, time-varying shale-exposure treatment with bank controls.
